title: ABARES agricultural commodity trade — historical values, volumes, prices and forecasts
publisher: Australian Bureau of Agricultural and Resource Economics and Sciences (ABARES), Department of Agriculture, Fisheries and Forestry (DAFF)
state: discovery-only; no connector, no database write, no trade_records rows

premise_falsifier.result: PARTIAL / CONDITIONAL — DEFER under the current schema
premise_falsifier.reason: ABARES publishes accessible agricultural trade values and some commodity volumes/unit values under CC BY 4.0, but the usable value series is ABS-derived and not additive with ABS; AFF volumes are empty; statistical volume/price columns are indices with estimates/forecasts; commodity statistics mix fiscal, marketing and calendar years plus ABS/ABARES/FAO/USDA sources and ABARES estimates; ABS confidentiality suppression can understate totals.
premise_falsifier.recommendation: DEFER a trade_records builder. Only a bounded AFF actual-value slice (FY, values only, source-overlap guard) is potentially defensible after schema work.

valuation_basis.exports: Free on board (FOB) at the Australian port of export; freight/insurance beyond the Australian customs border excluded.

valuation_basis.aff_workbook_note: The AFF workbooks themselves do not print FOB/CIF labels; they cite ABS ITGS 5368.0. The definitions page is the published basis.

classification.partner: Published partner labels including 'EU' (as one), 'Other', 'No Country Details' and 'Australia (Re-Imports)'; not ISO country codes.
classification.period: AFF FY; Table 4 FY; Commodity Statistics may use fiscal year, October–September marketing year or calendar year.

overlap.overlap: OECD publishes CIF/FOB margins, not trade values.
overlap.consequence: Different measure; never sum a margin with a value.

overlap.overlap: AFF includes agriculture, fisheries and forestry; Table 4 is agriculture-only; Commodity Statistics are commodity-specific and often marketing-year based; Total sheets duplicate partner/commodity breakdowns.
overlap.consequence: Do not add AFF to Table 4 or Commodity Statistics; do not add AFF Total to its partner/commodity sheets.
Not Australian trade; never mix into an Australian total.

overlap.overlap: ABS suppresses some commodity detail; ABARES states totals can understate true value and creates unofficial sugar/rice estimates.
overlap.consequence: Published totals are not a complete official actual; do not label unofficial estimates as ABS statistics.

schema_blockers: No volume_unit, price_unit or unit_multiplier; kt/ML/Mt, $/t, US$/t and indices would be ambiguous.
No period_basis/marketing_year; financial_year cannot represent Oct–Sep or calendar-year series without loss.
No forecast_vintage/release_id/estimate_status; 'estimated' alone cannot separate a forecast from a later estimate or actual.
No source-overlap/additivity guard; the API would sum ABARES with ABS/REQ.
No classification_system field; ABARES/AHECC TopN and ABARES commodity identifiers would collide with HS.
No partner_type/partner_code; EU as one, Other, No Country Details and re-import buckets are not ISO countries.
No explicit total/component/index marker on trade_records rows.
No field to distinguish ABARES unofficial sugar/rice estimates or ABS-confidentiality undercounts from official ABS actuals.

recommendation.reason: The broad premise (a clean, independent, additive agricultural trade value and volume series) is not met. The value series is ABS-derived and only 2021-22+; AFF volumes are empty; statistical volumes/prices are indices; commodity statistics mix marketing years, sources and estimates; forecasts are not actuals.
bounded_sequence_if_resumed: Phase A: AFF actual values only, one breakdown per dataset, FY 2021-22..2025-26 complete plus partial 2026-27 provisional; add source-overlap guard first; no volumes, no forecasts.

Phase B: commodity volumes/unit values only after adding volume_unit, price_unit, period_basis/marketing_year and classification_system; one commodity chapter at a time; keep ABARES estimates estimated; no national total.
Forecasts: separate product with vintage/forecast flag; never mix with AFF actuals.
must_not: Do not add ABARES values to ABS or DISR REQ.
Do not treat AFF Total and partner/commodity sheets as additive.
Do not map Table 4 indices to trade_volume or trade_price.
Do not label forecasts or ABARES unofficial estimates as observed/verified actuals.
Do not derive a national total from commodity chapters.

premise_falsifier_restated: ABARES publishes accessible agricultural trade values and some commodity volumes/unit values under CC BY 4.0. However, the usable value series is ABS-derived and non-additive with ABS; AFF volumes are empty; statistical volume/price series are indices with estimates/forecasts; the long commodity series mix marketing years, sources and ABARES estimates; and ABS suppression/ABARES unofficial estimates break a clean official-actual series. The broad premise is not satisfied; defer rather than invent a series.
